summary:
We developed a video game inspired by the Apollo 13 mission, in which players take on the role of space crew members responsible for keeping the spacecraft's systems operational and ensuring the survival of everyone on board. Throughout the game, participants must move between different areas of the spacecraft, such as power, oxygen, navigation, and communications, to handle critical situations and complete mission-related objectives.

The challenge is addressed through a gameplay mechanic centered on decision-making and teamwork. Each player is assigned a specific role and must collaborate with others to solve problems as quickly as possible. This allows players to experience the pressure and difficulties faced by the real Apollo 13 crew when an emergency jeopardized both the success of the mission and the lives of the astronauts.

The importance of this project lies in its ability to combine entertainment and education. Through an interactive experience, users can gain a deeper understanding of the challenges encountered during the mission, as well as the importance of communication, coordination, and problem-solving in high-risk situations. In this way, the game aims to showcase one of the most significant events in the history of space exploration in a dynamic and accessible manner.
details:
The game is made by Daniel Tapia Valencia and Nataly Rodriguez Rosas.

The game is about solving missions, try to survive to some random events, Admin the resources and learn about what happene in the "Apollo 13" mission.

We did two type of levels: "Easy" and "Hard"

In the easy level you can solve the missions like playing some minigames and if you complete the mission you can see hat happened in that stage in the "Apollo 13" mission. We added some features like eating, drinking water and doing excercise.

When you eat you can see a message of why is that kind of food important for the crew. When you do excercise you can even see a message of why is excercise important, if you don´t do excercise in time, you will start to lose healt.

The tools we used are python and some of its libraries. We used VS Code.

The idea was all of us, but for the code we used Copilot and Claude like help tools.

We tried to simulate space travel in a game. We hope you like it.
